effectEntries.effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
effectEntries.shortEffect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

descriptions.text: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
接触技を使う時 相手の守りの効果を無視して 本来の1/4のダメージを与える。 相手の守りの効果以外は発動される。
